text:
maya: quick FYI 1 pilot customers paused Dedicated until we can show a compact per-route economics + short error-slice view. need a narrow unblock this quarter.

tony: propose tiny ship: per-route 24h cost table, error-rate sparkline per route, and an "open sampled trace" link from each route row. no span histograms for v1. est: 3 dev days + 2 infra days.

ben: attribution is the gating risk. can we accept nightly-batch attribution for MVP with an accuracy SLA (~10% for top routes)? if not, need route-id propagation in billing which is heavier.

sarah: customers want a short acceptance checklist: data freshness (<15m), route delta vs nightly baseline within 10% for top routes, trace link resolves, and error classes present for 24h without flapping. i'll schedule two 30m sessions.

ton y: sampling plan: deterministic reservoir per-route with sticky sample_id so traces across services correlate. i'll run a 48h spike to validate bias and post the pseudo code.

ben: infra asks: ephemeral validation pipeline (72h) and a small billing-tag handshake to carry route_id. ops said they will approve once we have a ticket + short scope doc.

ops-bot: INF ticket placeholder created by ben. ops requested scope doc before approval.

devex-bot: Reminder 1 add brief feature blurb to SDK changelog and update release notes template (assignee: @maya).

maya: acceptance gates (proposal): 1) route cost within 10% of offline batch for top routes; 2) error-rate signal stable for 24h; 3) docs + runbook published; 4) one customer acceptance signoff. owners: tony (sampling + impl), ben (infra), sarah (customer validation), maya (docs/comms).

sarah: pilots also asked for a simple "what-if batching" slider as a stretch demo. mark as MVP-B.

ton y: i'll open a spike card today (2d). if reuse of nightly pipeline works, impl drops to ~3d. otherwise +4d for tag plumbing.

ben: i'll file infra ticket and request ephemeral instance. will include coverage metrics fields (coverage_pct, estimated_variance) in the table so customers see caveats.

maya: proposed split: MVP-A = cost table + error sparkline + trace-link (pilot beta). MVP-B = batching slider + sampling controls + richer error buckets. target MVP-A for end of sprint. next sync Wed 10am to freeze acceptance tests.

ben: cards created and tagging billing + ops.

maya: thanks all 1 keep updates on the card so the pilots get unblocked this quarter. :thumbsup:
